title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Claims Manual: Coverage, Exclusions and Late Reports
content:
## 1. Coverage on the loss date

A claim under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage is covered only when the vehicle carried physical damage that was pending inspection, active or (for a comprehensive loss) in storage on the loss date, and the auto policy was in force on the loss date. While the vehicle is in storage only comprehensive losses are covered.

## 2. Coverage part by cause of loss

| Cause of loss | Coverage part |
|---|---|
| Collision with another vehicle or object | Collision |
| Rollover | Collision |
| Hit-and-run collision | Collision |
| Theft, vandalism, fire, hail, wind, flood, falling objects, glass breakage | Comprehensive |
| Hitting an animal | Comprehensive (the animal-strike coverage part of every deductible option) |

## 3. Grounds of denial

A claim is denied when:
- the driver was excluded on the auto policy on the loss date;
- the driver was a household member who should have been listed and was not;
- the vehicle was used for a transportation network company and no rideshare endorsement was carried;
- the damage is wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown, freezing, or road damage to tires alone; or
- the loss was intentional.

Loss in market value after a repair (diminished value) is not paid; no deductible option covers first-party diminished value.

## 4. Late reports

A loss is decided at the desk only when it is reported no more than the late-report review period (60 calendar days on every option) after the loss date; a later report is referred to a claims supervisor and is not decided at the desk. Report lateness is counted in calendar days from the loss date as day 0 to the report date, and a report on the last day is timely. Both dates are read from the claim's loss report.

| Loss date | Report date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Day 0 | Day 60 | Timely; decided at the desk |
| Day 0 | Day 61 | Referred to a claims supervisor |

## 5. One claim per vehicle per occurrence

A claim number is assigned once per damaged vehicle per occurrence; a second report of the same loss is attached to the existing claim. The check matches the coverage of the damaged vehicle and the occurrence reference on the claim file.

## 6. Closing and reopening

A claim is closed when every payment due has been issued, when it is denied, when the estimate is below the deductible, or when the customer withdraws it. A closed claim is reopened for a supplement, a recovered theft vehicle or a recovery.
